overview_description: Manage rental assets, the profiles that price them and the hours they are available.
intro: Rental assets are the things customers can hire, each priced and scheduled by a rental asset profile. These endpoints list, create, update, cancel, reactivate and delete assets and profiles, and read and set each asset's availability. The module has 14 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **Single records come back under `rental_asset` or `rental_asset_profile`.** Listings put their records under `data`.
**`rental_asset_uuid` and `rental_asset_id` take the same value.** Both are the rental asset's `id`; the cancel and reactivate paths name it `rental_asset_id`.
**Every session of a new profile needs a price.** A session with no `rental_asset_profile_session_prices` is refused with `400`.
**Update rental asset availability takes a list and returns no body.** It returns `204`; read the asset to see the stored hours.
**Cancel sets `status` to `inactive` and reactivate sets it to `active`.** Both take an empty object as the body, and cancelling an already cancelled asset is refused.
**Listings page by cursor.** Pass `limit` and the previous page's `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor`, and stop when `has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List rental asset availability
endpoints.summary: Lists each rental asset with its schedule, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page under `data`, one row per rental asset, with its profile, `session_list`, `schedule_list` and the available and unavailable times. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality and `filter_<field>_<operator>` otherwise.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, as in `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of availability rows under `data`.

endpoints.title: Update rental asset availability
endpoints.summary: Sets the weekly or custom hours of one or more rental assets.
endpoints.description: Send a `rental_assets` list. Each entry names an asset by `id` and carries `rental_asset_availability` for weekly hours or `rental_asset_custom_availability` for custom hours. An entry with only the `id` is accepted. In the tested flow, the asset's `use_custom_availability` is set to `true` before custom hours are sent.

204.description: The hours are saved. There is no body.

endpoints.title: List rental asset profiles
endpoints.summary: Lists rental asset profiles, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of profiles under `data`. Each profile carries its currency, sessions with prices and hours, and the rental assets that use it. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality and `filter_<field>_<operator>` otherwise.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, as in `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Create a rental asset profile
endpoints.summary: Creates a rental asset profile and returns it under `rental_asset_profile`.
endpoints.description: Send the profile under `rental_asset_profile`: `name`, `display_name`, `currency` and `rental_asset_profile_sessions`. Each session needs at least one price in `rental_asset_profile_session_prices`; a session without one is refused with `400`.

rental_asset_profile_session_prices.description: A session without a price is refused with `400`.

endpoints.title: List rental assets
endpoints.summary: Lists rental assets, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of rental assets under `data`, each with its profile, status and availability. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality and `filter_<field>_<operator>` otherwise.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, as in `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of rental assets under `data`.

endpoints.title: Create a rental asset
endpoints.summary: Creates a rental asset and returns it under `rental_asset`.
endpoints.description: Send the asset under `rental_asset` with its `name` and the `id` of its `rental_asset_profile`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a rental asset profile
endpoints.summary: Returns one rental asset profile under `rental_asset_profile`.
endpoints.description: Returns the profile with its currency, sessions, prices, hours and rental assets.

404.description: No profile has that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Update a rental asset profile
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `rental_asset_profile`, such as `display_name`. Read the profile afterwards to see the stored values.

endpoints.title: Delete a rental asset profile
endpoints.description: Deletes the profile. Reading it afterwards returns `404`.

endpoints.title: Update a rental asset
endpoints.summary: Changes a rental asset and returns it under `rental_asset`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `rental_asset`, such as `description` or `use_custom_availability`. The updated asset comes back with a higher `version`.

endpoints.title: Delete a rental asset
endpoints.summary: Deletes a rental asset and returns no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the asset. Reading it afterwards returns `404`.

204.description: The rental asset is deleted. There is no body.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a rental asset
endpoints.description: Returns the asset with its profile, status, weekly and custom hours, and custom attributes.

404.description: No rental asset has that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Cancel a rental asset
endpoints.summary: Cancels a rental asset, setting its `status` to `inactive`.
endpoints.description: Send an empty object as the body. The asset comes back under `rental_asset`, and its `status` reads `inactive`. Cancelling an asset that is already cancelled is refused with a `4xx` status.

parameters.name: rental_asset_id
parameters.description: The rental asset's `id`. The same value as `rental_asset_uuid` in the other paths.

endpoints.title: Reactivate a rental asset
endpoints.summary: Reactivates a cancelled rental asset, setting its `status` to `active`.
endpoints.description: Send an empty object as the body. The asset comes back under `rental_asset`, and its `status` reads `active`.

parameters.name: rental_asset_id
parameters.description: The rental asset's `id`. The same value as `rental_asset_uuid` in the other paths.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust it over `next_cursor`, which can be stale on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Send as `cursor` to read the next page.

records.description: Offset pages only: total matching records, not the page's length.

next_page.description: Offset pages only: the literal string `NULL` at the end of a listing, not JSON null.
